name: sanjaya
description: Live agent trajectory viewer for Antigravity and Jetski. Renders conversations as an interactive DAG (phases, turns, steps), a latency timeline, tool and token/context analytics, and a subagent tree, with a step inspector, annotations, steering, forking, and Markdown export in the Auxiliary Pane.
suggestedPrompts: Open Sanjaya to watch this conversation's trajectory live
Show the subagent tree and token usage for this conversation in Sanjaya
Find the failing tool calls in this trajectory with Sanjaya
